newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai, U.S. firms set up $29 mln foodstuff jv.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai, U.S. firms set up $29 mln foodstuff jv.

text.p: Shanghai Guanshenyuan Group, producer of White Rabbit candy, has set up a joint venture with U.S. based investment firm New Bridge Capital Ltd with initial investment of $29.88 million, officials said on Wednesday.
The 50-50 venture, to begin operations in April, will produce candy using the White Rabbit brand, a Guanshenyuan official said. Guanshenyuan will manage the joint venture.
A New Bridge official said the investment firm also had stakes in two other joint ventures in China, totalling about $30 million, he said.
The company is funded by several U.S. banks and brokerages led by Merrill Lynch, the official said but gave no further details.
